$comment: The mods the Mods page recommends (framework-ui.md F10): each is installed from the latest release of `repo`, which carries one signed package per mod (<id>-<version>.codexmod; scripts/release/mods.mjs). Names, descriptions and glyphs are their mod.json's (mods/manifests.test.mjs keeps them so).

mods.name: Live usage
mods.description: Your limits between whole percentage points, your pace and the time left, each chat's share, and a reserve that holds messages until your limit resets.

mods.name: Split view
mods.description: Two or more chats open at once: a split view beside the chat you are in, with up to three chats live, each with its own composer, and a chat beside yours in the side panel.

mods.name: Smart composer
mods.description: Luna in the composer: it finishes what you're typing, asks what's unclear before a message goes, and gives each message the reasoning effort its task needs.

mods.name: Account switcher
mods.description: Several ChatGPT accounts in one app: each kept signed in, and your chats moved between them between turns so every account's usage is used and fewer chats hit a limit.

mods.name: Better questions
mods.description: The agent asks you with a form, in a window of its own or by iMessage, and Codex's own questions open there too.

mods.name: Chat settings
mods.description: A chat's settings in one panel: Codex's, every mod's and each skill's, with a switch to use a skill in that chat and the parameters skills declare.

mods.name: UI tweaks
mods.description: A wider chat, bigger or smaller text, compact rows, the agent's steps open, and the parts of the app you never use hidden.

mods.name: Project orchestrator
mods.description: A project's orchestrator: a chat that learns the project, settles its open questions with you, hears what its other chats do, and coordinates the work with you.

mods.name: Claude Code
mods.description: Claude Code as an agent in Codex: its chats beside Codex's, each a real Claude Code session in the project's folder, with its steps, approvals and answers in Codex's own look.
